jobs.title: Marketing Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About The Team**

This is an in-house role for a family of brands built around two influential Los Angeles attorneys and the communities they've grown. This isn’t your typical legal marketing job it is fast-paced, fun and extremely creative.

You'll keep the marketing systems behind them running. Each brand has its own design system, audience and voice. Your job is to keep all of them organized, accurate and easy to work with.

**The role**

This role is a flexible hybrid role requiring up to 2 days a week in office.

You own the systems behind our marketing: design assets, websites, event pages, email lists and newsletters. This is a hands-on seat: you build it, organize it, keep it accurate and make it repeatable.

We're looking for the person who makes the whole team's life easier. You hear an idea once, figure out what needs to happen, and run with it. And when you see something that could be better, you flag it and fix it.

You'll report to our Head of Marketing, who sets the overall marketing strategy. You'll work closely with our Social Media Manager, who owns social media, while you own everything that happens after someone clicks: the page they land on, the form they fill out, the email they get next.

In a typical day you'll:

* design a YouTube thumbnail or event graphic in Canva
* update a web page or build an event registration page
* tag, clean and segment contacts
* upload podcast episode with optimized title and description
* update team spreadsheets
* conduct research for new marketing initiative

We don't measure this job in tasks checked off. We measure it in systems that run without anyone chasing them, newsletters that go out on time, and a team that can always find what it needs.

**What you'll do**

**Design**

* Create Canva graphics as needed, using each brand's design system
* Design YouTube thumbnails in Canva for each brand's channel
* Manage the asset library: logos, photos, templates and files, organized so anyone on the team can find them

**Web and events**

* Make simple website updates across our brands
* Build event registration pages and ticketing workflows
* Set up payment flows and confirmation emails, and test them end to end before launch

**Email and CRM**

* Organize and maintain our contact lists
* Tag and segment contacts so the right people get the right emails
* Build and maintain automated email sequences
* Produce newsletter from draft to publish + occasional segmented/targeted emails

**Podcast**

* Upload fully edited podcast episodes to YouTube and audio platforms
* Create SEO optimized episode titles & descriptions
* Track downloads and analytics in team spreadsheet

**Inquiries and sponsors**

* Route inbound inquiries from website forms to the right person
* Support sponsor pitching as needed, from research to outreach to follow-up

**Make things better**

* Spot what's slowing the team down and suggest the solution: a better template, a cleaner process, a shared checklist
* Proofread and double-check everything before it goes out
* Look at what's working and suggest ways to improve it

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves**

* Minimum of 3 years in marketing operations/project management
* Strong Canva skills: you build clean, on-brand graphics and thumbnails from a design system
* Hands-on experience updating and organizing CRM through Constant Contact or similar newsletter platform: lists, tags, segments and automations
* Experience updating websites, landing pages on Kajabi and Squarespace
* Experience building event registration pages and ticketing in Eventbrite and Kajabi
* Highly organized: you name files consistently, document how things work and leave systems cleaner than you found them
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier
* Clear, careful writing and an eye for typos and broken links
* Experience using Claude and other AI tools to speed up design, writing and setup, with the judgment to keep the result accurate and on-brand

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience supporting personal brands or founder-led organizations
* Payment and checkout tools such as Stripe
* Sponsor or partnership outreach
* Experience working in the legal industry

**What success looks like after 90 days**

* The asset library is organized, and anyone on the team can find what they need
* Newsletters go out on schedule for every brand
* Contact lists are clean, tagged and segmented
* Event pages, payments and confirmations work end to end without manual fixes
* Every website inquiry reaches the right person within one business day

**You might be our person if…**

* **You hear it once and get it.** Give you the goal, and you figure out the path.
* **You make the team's life easier.** You notice the file no one can find or the form going to the wrong inbox, and you fix it before anyone asks.
* **You work toward the same goal we do.** You care how the whole team does, not just what's on your own list.
* **You have urgency.** If it can be done today, it doesn't sit on your list for three days.
* **You take ownership.** You see what needs doing and do it.
* **You catch the details.** The typo, the broken link, the wrong date: you find it before it goes out.
* **You're creative but practical.** You come up with a better way, then actually build it.
* **You adapt.** Priorities change and opportunities pop up. You pivot without losing momentum.
* **You take pride in your work.** You don't ask "Is this good enough?" You ask "How can I make this better?"

**This is not the job for you if…**

* You need constant direction or frequent reminders
* You enjoy doing the same thing every day
* You stop at roadblocks
* You rush through work and miss important details
* You'd rather protect your own lane than help the team win

**How to apply**

Send your résumé and examples of your work. We’d love to see examples of systems and designs you’ve created.

Please include:

* Canva graphics or YouTube thumbnails you designed
* An email sequence, newsletter or e

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC I / CRC II)
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC I / CRC II) **Location:** Los Angeles, CA (On-Site) **Employment Type:** W-2, Full-Time (or Part-Time transitioning to Full-Time) **Schedule:** Monday - Friday, standard clinic hours (No evenings or weekends) **Start Date:** Immediate / ASAP **Compensation:** $25.00 - $35.00 / hour (commensurate with experience)

**Position Overview** We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Clinical Research Coordinator (Entry-Level / CRC I or CRC II) to join our growing clinical research site in Los Angeles, California. In this role, you will manage the day-to-day clinical and administrative operations of assigned clinical trials under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) and Site Leadership. This is an ideal opportunity for a coordinator with a strong foundation in clinical trials who wants to grow their career in a supportive, weekday-only clinic environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Study Execution & Protocol Compliance:** Coordinate clinical trial activities from startup through closeout in strict accordance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and FDA regulations.
* **Patient Recruitment & Screening:** Prescreen clinic schedules and patient charts, conduct recruitment outreach, explain study procedures to prospective participants, and facilitate the Informed Consent process alongside the PI.
* **Study Visits & Procedures:** Conduct scheduled participant visits, obtain vital signs, collect medical histories, administer questionnaires, and perform or coordinate specimen collection, processing, and shipping (IATA).
* **Data Management:** Accurately record source documentation and enter timely clinical data into Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems; resolve data queries within sponsor timelines.
* **Sponsor & Monitor Coordination:** Prepare for and host Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and closeout visits; serve as a primary point of contact for Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and sponsors.
* **Safety & Regulatory Support:** Track and report Adverse Events (AEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) promptly to the PI, sponsor, and IRB; assist with maintaining Investigator Site Files (ISF) and regulatory binders.
* **Investigational Product (IP) Accountability:** Receive, store, dispense, and maintain accurate accountability logs for study drug or device supplies as delegated.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience working as a Clinical Research Coordinator or in direct clinical trial operations (open to multi-specialty backgrounds; no specific therapeutic area required).
* **Knowledge Base:** Solid working understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory documentation, source documentation standards, and general EDC/EMR navigation.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, clear communication with patients and physicians, and the ability to manage multiple protocols simultaneously.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the United States as a W-2 employee, able to commute reliably to Los Angeles, CA, and available to start immediately.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)**

* California CPT-1 Phlebotomy Certification or hands-on blood draw and lab processing experience.
* ACRP (CCRC) or SOCRA (CCRP) certification.
* Current GCP and IATA certifications (or willingness to complete upon hire).

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Hourly Pay:** $25.00 - $35.00 / hour, based on coordinator level and certifications.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package (Full-Time):**
* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
* **Work-Life Balance:** Predictable Monday through Friday daytime schedule with no evening or weekend shifts.

**How to Apply** Please submit your updated resume along with your target hourly rate and earliest available start date.

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Manager / Content Creator
jobs.description:
**About The Team**

This is an in-house role for a family of brands built around two influential Los Angeles attorneys and the communities they've grown.

The pace is fast and the energy is fun. This role is perfect for a creative who loves making content that’s equal parts entertaining and educational, and who can turn legal know-how into posts people actually want to watch, save and share.

**The role**

This is a flexible hybrid role that can require up to 2 days a week in office.

You’ll own the social presence across multiple accounts. You’ll often adapt and cross-post content between brands while keeping each one’s voice distinct.

You will be responsible for creating monthly editorial calendars and daily content for multiple accounts. This is a hands-on seat: you plan it, make it, publish it and report on it.

You'll report to the Head of Marketing, who sets the overall marketing strategy. You run social day to day: what goes where, when, and how it's cross-posted. From time to time you'll get priorities to work into the calendar, and you'll get sign-off on each month's plan.

While the first 30 days there will be some oversight and feedback to ensure brand alignment, this is not a role where someone approves every post.

**What you'll do**

* Manage social media across multiple accounts (business accounts + 2 personal brands)
* Build a monthly content strategy and editorial calendar for each brand
* Source raw material from owners and team to keep the pipeline moving
* Pitch creative concepts, recurring series and timely ideas
* Follow each brand's guidelines: colors, fonts, logos, tone and visual style
* Edit raw clips into in-feed Reels and Shorts via CapCut
* Design graphics, carousels, Story frames and promo assets in Canva
* Strategically tag and collabs with sister accounts
* Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook
* Run cross-posting between the firm accounts and personal brand accounts, tailored to each
* Capture occasional behind-the-scenes and team moments
* Ability to turn around same day requests when needed
* Develop social media content marketing plans; write, proofread, photograph, and edit graphics and video.
* Manage publishing with scheduling tools such as Metricool or SproutSocial
* Monitor social listening and community conversations
* Apply SEO and keyword research to content, then track social media analytics, Google Analytics, web analytics, and marketing online analytics.
* Use performance insights to improve relevant content, helping audiences find useful information and engage with the brand
* Manage comments and DMs during engagement windows
* Flag strong comments as content ideas and escalate inquiries to the right person
* Share a monthly snapshot of what worked, what didn't and what to test next
* Deliver a quarterly performance report per brand

**What we're looking for**

* 5+ years managing social media for businesses and personal brands
* Experience running several accounts at once, each with its own voice
* Strong Canva skills: you build clean, on-brand graphics quickly
* Strong Capcut skills: editing short-form videos for social
* Experience working within brand guidelines and keeping multiple brands consistent
* Sharp copywriting: hooks, captions and calls to action
* Fluency in Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook, and how each one behaves differently
* Ghostwriting in someone else's voice
* Highly organized, comfortable with fast turnarounds and changing priorities
* A portfolio showing work you personally made

**Nice-to-haves**

* Scheduling platforms like Sprout Social, MetriCool or HeyOrca
* Experience creating content for personal brands and founder-lead organizations
* Podcast or event content promotion
* Using AI tools to speed up ideas, editing and production

**How to apply**

Send your résumé and a portfolio or links to your work. Your portfolio matters more to us than your résumé. No cover letter needed.

**Please include:**

* 2 Carousel design samples
* 2 Short-form videos you edited
* Results you can share (growth, engagement, inquiries)

Pay: $90,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE: Complex Sales Coordinator**

**REPORTS TO:** Director of Sales & Marketing

**Purpose for the Position:** To act as personal support for the Sales Department. To detail all in-coming functions, maintain room block inventories, and qualify all in-coming sales calls.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Performs general duties including typing, dictation and answering telephone.
* Audits Sales System (STS, Delphi, et al) for accuracy, space conflicts and space control on behalf of the department director.
* Processes all paper flow in and out of Sales management offices.
* Maintains a filing system of reports and pertinent records.
* Answers/forwards client requests, complaints or questions in a courteous timely manner.
* Receives, opens and sorts all sales department mail daily.
* Sends and receives faxes.
* Makes photocopies.
* Monitors and inventories all office supplies.
* Orders supplies as approved by the Sales Department.
* Attends sales meetings. Types and distributes minutes.
* Assists administrative office staff during periods of absence.
* Contacts managerial and staff personnel for collection of dates, statistics, and reports. Performs follow-up reports or special assignments.
* May compose replies to correspondence based on organizational practice, policies, and procedures at the direction of the Department head.
* May assign and distribute work under general direction to other clerical and office associates.
* Completes projects as determined by the Department head.

**To do this kind of work, you must be able to:**

* Provides professional and courteous guest service at all times.
* Understand the principles relating to the product you are selling.
* Organize your own activities to make the best use of your time.
* Express yourself well when talking to potential buyers and sellers, discuss features of the products and services involved and convince the other person of both your knowledge and integrity.
* Use arithmetic in computing the cost of sale to the customer.
* Maintain enthusiasm and interest throughout all conferences with buyers and sellers.
* Keep accurate records of contacts, sales, and purchases.
* Be available on nights, weekends, and holidays.

**Physical Demands:** Lifting up to 20 lbs. Maximum with frequent lifting and/or carrying of objects weighing up to 10lbs. Requires walking or standing to a significant degree, reaching, handling, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing.

**Environmental Conditions:** Inside: Protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes. A job is considered “inside” if the worker spends approximately 75% or more of the time inside.

**Math Skills:** Requires mathematical development sufficient to be able to: add, subtract, multiply, and divide all units of measure.

**Language Skills:** Must have developed language skills to the point to be able to: Read newspapers, periodicals, journals, and manuals. Write business letters, summaries and reports using prescribed format and conforming to all rules of punctuation, grammar, diction and style. Participate in discussions and debates. Speak extemporaneously on a variety of subjects.

**Relationships to Data, People and Things:**

**Data:** Coordinating: Determining time, place, and sequence of operations or action to be taken on the basis of analysis of data; executing determination and/or reporting on events.

**People:** Persuading: Influencing others in favor of a product or service or point of view.

**Things:** Handling: Using body members, hand tools, and/or special devices to work, move, or carry objects or materials. Involves little or no latitude for judgment with regard to attainment of standards or in selecting appropriate tools, objects or materials.

**Specific Vocational Preparation:** On the job training or essential experience in less responsible jobs over 1 year and including 2 years; Associates or Bachelor’s degree helpful.

Denino’s Pizzeria & Tavern is seeking a detail-oriented Pizza Purchasing Assistant to support purchasing and inventory activities for daily restaurant operations. The successful candidate will help source ingredients, communicate with suppliers, track orders, monitor stock levels, and ensure that the kitchen has the materials needed to maintain consistent food quality and service.

* Food Purchasing Assistant
* Restaurant Procurement Assistant
* Kitchen Inventory Assistant

* Problem-solving and organization

Work Environment

This position supports restaurant purchasing and kitchen operations in a fast-paced pizzeria environment. The assistant will communicate with suppliers and restaurant staff, maintain purchasing records, and help ensure ingredients and supplies are available when needed.

jobs.title: Pizza Procurement Coordinator

Napoli Pizza is seeking a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Pizza Procurement Assistant to support purchasing and supply coordination for daily restaurant operations. This position assists with sourcing ingredients, monitoring inventory, preparing purchase orders, communicating with suppliers, and ensuring that essential kitchen materials are available when needed.

The ideal candidate has strong organizational and communication skills, an understanding of restaurant purchasing procedures, and the ability to coordinate multiple supply requirements while supporting quality standards and cost control.

* Assist with purchasing ingredients and supplies required for daily pizza restaurant operations.

* Communicate with suppliers to confirm product availability, pricing, delivery schedules, and order details.
* Prepare and maintain purchase orders, invoices, and procurement records.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify items that need replenishment.
* Coordinate with kitchen managers and staff to understand ingredient and supply requirements.
* Help compare supplier prices, product quality, and purchasing options.
* Track incoming deliveries and verify quantities against purchase orders.
* Report damaged, missing, or incorrect products to suppliers and management.
* Maintain organized records of supplier contacts, pricing, and purchasing activity.
* Assist with monitoring food costs and identifying opportunities to reduce purchasing expenses.
* Support proper ingredient storage and stock rotation procedures.
* Communicate potential shortages or delivery delays to the appropriate team members.
* Follow company purchasing procedures and food safety requirements.
* Assist management with improving procurement processes and maintaining reliable supply levels.

Qualifications and Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional business or supply chain education preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing, inventory coordination, restaurant operations, or administrative support is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of food ingredients and restaurant supply requirements.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate purchasing and inventory records.
* Basic computer skills, including spreadsheets, email, and data entry.
* Good attention to detail when reviewing orders, invoices, and deliveries.
* Ability to communicate professionally with suppliers and internal teams.
* Strong time management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with kitchen and management staff.

Preferred Skills

* Experience purchasing ingredients for a pizzeria, Italian restaurant, or food service business.
* Familiarity with pizza ingredients, specialty cheeses, flour varieties, and tomato products.
* Knowledge of inventory tracking and purchase order procedures.
* Ability to compare supplier quotations and evaluate product value.
* Familiarity with point-of-sale, inventory, or procurement software.
* Understanding of food storage, stock rotation, and product freshness.

* Potential employee meal discounts, where available.

* Collaborative restaurant team environment.

Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting relevant experience in purchasing, inventory management, restaurant operations, or administrative coordination. Applicants should demonstrate strong attention to detail, communication skills, and an ability to support an organized procurement process.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

  
  

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative NYC
jobs.description:
#### **Who we are**

At Software Improvement Group (SIG), we empower organisations to enhance their software quality through in-depth source code analysis and customised strategic advice. Our software assurance platform, Sigrid, combined with our expert IT consultants, allows our clients to take full control of their software environments. This ensures that their technology becomes a driver of success rather than a source of risk. With a strong market presence and ambitious growth plans for the coming years, we are looking for individuals who want to help us achieve these goals.

#### **Where you come in**

The Business Development Representative (BDR) plays a vital role as the link between marketing and sales. The BDR is responsible for developing, qualifying, and nurturing leads. This includes gathering intelligence, profiling relevant prospects, and converting them into opportunities.

Leads may be generated through various channels, including marketing efforts, focused BDRs, partners, consultants, or the Sales Executive’s personal network.

The BDR is tasked with following up on leads and will be in direct contact with decision-makers and stakeholders from some of the world’s largest companies. Collaboration with other BDRs, as well as teams in marketing, sales, and consulting, is essential to identify, qualify, and nurture business opportunities for SIG. In conjunction with your manager, specific targets will be set, such as the number of appointments or pipeline creation.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Gather intelligence through account profiling.
* Generate appointments for our sales team.
* Develop C-level business opportunities.
* Research the organizational structure of accounts and their businesses to create value propositions and identify opportunities.
* Orchestrate and conduct web presentations and conference calls as needed.
* Follow up on marketing campaigns.
* Enrich and maintain our Salesforce database with relevant details and insights.
* Prepare reports on the sales pipeline and forecasts.
* Prioritize weekly actions and outcomes, providing reports on successes and challenges each week.
* Attend trade shows and other sales and marketing events.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Generating a stronger, qualified pipeline.
* Accelerating deal velocity in enterprise opportunities.
* Increasing engagement from buying committees and key stakeholders.
* Achieving measurable revenue growth from existing customers.

#### **What's in it for you?**

Our company is experiencing rapid international growth, which presents a unique opportunity for you to collaborate with a diverse talent pool. We have a flat organizational structure that encourages entrepreneurship, initiative, and creativity.

You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. Our team consists of highly educated individuals, with the majority holding a Master's degree and 30% possessing a PhD in technology and software engineering.

We take pride in being the only company in the world with a laboratory accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 for software quality analysis. Additionally, we offer competitive compensation packages.

#### **Job Requirements**

Candidates should have a strong affinity with software to effectively engage with prospects and customers. You will thrive in this position if you possess perseverance and are comfortable making phone calls, engaging quickly and confidently without relying on a script.

* 4 to 7 years of experience in B2B lead generation and sales lead development.
* Experience working with enterprise-level customers and navigating complex buying processes.
* Ability to collaborate closely with sales teams and revenue leaders.
* Experience in North American markets, particularly in the enterprise or public sector, is a plus.
* Excellent phone and digital communication skills, including proficiency in email, Excel, LinkedIn, and CRM systems.
* Strong communication and listening skills at a senior level, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of a prospect's organization.
* Capability to handle objections without being discouraged by rejection; self-motivated, target-driven, and determined to exceed goals.
* Skill in turning objections into opportunities.
* Proactive in keeping knowledge and skills current.
* Understanding of the Software Quality market and its competition is a plus.

#### **About us**

Software Improvement Group (SIG) empowers organizations to govern the software their business runs on. Through complete portfolio analysis and tailored strategic advice, SIG helps companies embrace AI with control, improve software quality and security by focusing strategic efforts across people, process, and technology.  
  
Sigrid®—its software portfolio governance platform—analyzes over 400 billion lines of code across more than 30,000 systems and 300+ technologies, offering evidence-based insights to help organizations prioritize and manage their most critical IT initiatives.  
  
Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Amsterdam, SIG has offices in New York, Copenhagen, Brussels, and Frankfurt. The company complies with leading ISO/IEC standards, including 27001 and 17025, and co-developed ISO/IEC 5338—the new global standard for AI lifecycle management.

Combining expert consulting with over 25 years of industry-leading research, SIG is the global authority on continuous software portfolio governance.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

As a **Platform Technical Account Manager** at Integral Ad Science, you own the post-sales technical relationship for key clients. Your primary objectives are to drive efficiency and business value by helping clients fully leverage IAS's solutions, analyze customer workflows, identify opportunities for process improvement, and serve as a trusted advisor on best practices in digital media and ad tech environments.

**Note:** The responsibilities below reflect the core of this role today, but this is a fluid position, priorities, ownership areas, and day-to-day focus will shift as client needs and internal processes evolve. We're looking for someone comfortable operating in grey areas, without a fully defined playbook, and who can adapt accordingly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Advocacy & Service SLA Management:**  
  Serve as the main technical point of contact for key clients, delivering guidance on adopting and optimizing IAS' product offerings. Monitor and manage partner-specific technical support operations for IAS products and integrations to contractually defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response/resolution metrics. Review and interpret client contracts to understand defined SLAs, obligations, and risk areas, and apply that understanding to prioritize work, escalate appropriately, and guide client-facing decisions.
* **Workflow Automation:**  
  Audit internal processes to identify areas for automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven solutions to streamline day-to-day work.
* **Proactive Support:**  
  Monitor client health and key metrics with insights; flag anomalies, preempt issues, and ensure clients are positioned for success.
* **Enablement & Training:**  
  Deliver training sessions and supporting materials to upskill client teams on new AI-driven features and integrations.
* **Continuous Improvement & Feedback Loop:**  
  Gather and relay client feedback to Product and Engineering, advocating for new automation capabilities and smarter workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Partner closely with internal stakeholders across Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Operations to support account growth, align on feature roadmaps, and resolve complex technical escalations seamlessly. Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.
* **Client Travel:**  
  Occasional travel to client sites may be required to build relationships, deliver trainings, or conduct strategic technical reviews.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a TAM, platform support, or technical client success role (preferably in ad tech or SaaS).
* Experience working directly at or with major social platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and managing ongoing technical operations.
* Strong understanding of AI/automation in digital media; hands-on experience using or implementing AI tools.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and client communication skills, with a proven track record of managing and meeting strict contractual client SLAs.
* Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions, effectively collaborating across departments (Product, Engineering, Sales, BD) to achieve client objectives.

### **Success Measures**

**Job Title:** Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC I / CRC II) **Location:** Los Angeles, CA (On-Site) **Employment Type:** W-2, Full-Time (or Part-Time transitioning to Full-Time) **Schedule:** Monday - Friday, standard clinic hours (No evenings or weekends) **Start Date:** Immediate / ASAP **Compensation:** $25.00 - $35.00 / hour (commensurate with experience)

**Position Overview** We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Clinical Research Coordinator (Entry-Level / CRC I or CRC II) to join our growing clinical research site in Los Angeles, California. In this role, you will manage the day-to-day clinical and administrative operations of assigned clinical trials under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) and Site Leadership. This is an ideal opportunity for a coordinator with a strong foundation in clinical trials who wants to grow their career in a supportive, weekday-only clinic environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Study Execution & Protocol Compliance:** Coordinate clinical trial activities from startup through closeout in strict accordance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and FDA regulations.
* **Patient Recruitment & Screening:** Prescreen clinic schedules and patient charts, conduct recruitment outreach, explain study procedures to prospective participants, and facilitate the Informed Consent process alongside the PI.
* **Study Visits & Procedures:** Conduct scheduled participant visits, obtain vital signs, collect medical histories, administer questionnaires, and perform or coordinate specimen collection, processing, and shipping (IATA).
* **Data Management:** Accurately record source documentation and enter timely clinical data into Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems; resolve data queries within sponsor timelines.
* **Sponsor & Monitor Coordination:** Prepare for and host Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and closeout visits; serve as a primary point of contact for Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and sponsors.
* **Safety & Regulatory Support:** Track and report Adverse Events (AEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) promptly to the PI, sponsor, and IRB; assist with maintaining Investigator Site Files (ISF) and regulatory binders.
* **Investigational Product (IP) Accountability:** Receive, store, dispense, and maintain accurate accountability logs for study drug or device supplies as delegated.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience working as a Clinical Research Coordinator or in direct clinical trial operations (open to multi-specialty backgrounds; no specific therapeutic area required).
* **Knowledge Base:** Solid working understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory documentation, source documentation standards, and general EDC/EMR navigation.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, clear communication with patients and physicians, and the ability to manage multiple protocols simultaneously.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the United States as a W-2 employee, able to commute reliably to Los Angeles, CA, and available to start immediately.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)**

* California CPT-1 Phlebotomy Certification or hands-on blood draw and lab processing experience.
* ACRP (CCRC) or SOCRA (CCRP) certification.
* Current GCP and IATA certifications (or willingness to complete upon hire).

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Hourly Pay:** $25.00 - $35.00 / hour, based on coordinator level and certifications.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package (Full-Time):**
* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
* **Work-Life Balance:** Predictable Monday through Friday daytime schedule with no evening or weekend shifts.

**How to Apply** Please submit your updated resume along with your target hourly rate and earliest available start date.

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative NYC
new_jobs.description:
#### **Who we are**

At Software Improvement Group (SIG), we empower organisations to enhance their software quality through in-depth source code analysis and customised strategic advice. Our software assurance platform, Sigrid, combined with our expert IT consultants, allows our clients to take full control of their software environments. This ensures that their technology becomes a driver of success rather than a source of risk. With a strong market presence and ambitious growth plans for the coming years, we are looking for individuals who want to help us achieve these goals.

#### **Where you come in**

The Business Development Representative (BDR) plays a vital role as the link between marketing and sales. The BDR is responsible for developing, qualifying, and nurturing leads. This includes gathering intelligence, profiling relevant prospects, and converting them into opportunities.

Leads may be generated through various channels, including marketing efforts, focused BDRs, partners, consultants, or the Sales Executive’s personal network.

The BDR is tasked with following up on leads and will be in direct contact with decision-makers and stakeholders from some of the world’s largest companies. Collaboration with other BDRs, as well as teams in marketing, sales, and consulting, is essential to identify, qualify, and nurture business opportunities for SIG. In conjunction with your manager, specific targets will be set, such as the number of appointments or pipeline creation.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Gather intelligence through account profiling.
* Generate appointments for our sales team.
* Develop C-level business opportunities.
* Research the organizational structure of accounts and their businesses to create value propositions and identify opportunities.
* Orchestrate and conduct web presentations and conference calls as needed.
* Follow up on marketing campaigns.
* Enrich and maintain our Salesforce database with relevant details and insights.
* Prepare reports on the sales pipeline and forecasts.
* Prioritize weekly actions and outcomes, providing reports on successes and challenges each week.
* Attend trade shows and other sales and marketing events.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Generating a stronger, qualified pipeline.
* Accelerating deal velocity in enterprise opportunities.
* Increasing engagement from buying committees and key stakeholders.
* Achieving measurable revenue growth from existing customers.

#### **What's in it for you?**

Our company is experiencing rapid international growth, which presents a unique opportunity for you to collaborate with a diverse talent pool. We have a flat organizational structure that encourages entrepreneurship, initiative, and creativity.

You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. Our team consists of highly educated individuals, with the majority holding a Master's degree and 30% possessing a PhD in technology and software engineering.

We take pride in being the only company in the world with a laboratory accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 for software quality analysis. Additionally, we offer competitive compensation packages.

#### **Job Requirements**

Candidates should have a strong affinity with software to effectively engage with prospects and customers. You will thrive in this position if you possess perseverance and are comfortable making phone calls, engaging quickly and confidently without relying on a script.

* 4 to 7 years of experience in B2B lead generation and sales lead development.
* Experience working with enterprise-level customers and navigating complex buying processes.
* Ability to collaborate closely with sales teams and revenue leaders.
* Experience in North American markets, particularly in the enterprise or public sector, is a plus.
* Excellent phone and digital communication skills, including proficiency in email, Excel, LinkedIn, and CRM systems.
* Strong communication and listening skills at a senior level, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of a prospect's organization.
* Capability to handle objections without being discouraged by rejection; self-motivated, target-driven, and determined to exceed goals.
* Skill in turning objections into opportunities.
* Proactive in keeping knowledge and skills current.
* Understanding of the Software Quality market and its competition is a plus.

#### **About us**

Software Improvement Group (SIG) empowers organizations to govern the software their business runs on. Through complete portfolio analysis and tailored strategic advice, SIG helps companies embrace AI with control, improve software quality and security by focusing strategic efforts across people, process, and technology.  
  
Sigrid®—its software portfolio governance platform—analyzes over 400 billion lines of code across more than 30,000 systems and 300+ technologies, offering evidence-based insights to help organizations prioritize and manage their most critical IT initiatives.  
  
Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Amsterdam, SIG has offices in New York, Copenhagen, Brussels, and Frankfurt. The company complies with leading ISO/IEC standards, including 27001 and 17025, and co-developed ISO/IEC 5338—the new global standard for AI lifecycle management.

Combining expert consulting with over 25 years of industry-leading research, SIG is the global authority on continuous software portfolio governance.

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

As a **Platform Technical Account Manager** at Integral Ad Science, you own the post-sales technical relationship for key clients. Your primary objectives are to drive efficiency and business value by helping clients fully leverage IAS's solutions, analyze customer workflows, identify opportunities for process improvement, and serve as a trusted advisor on best practices in digital media and ad tech environments.

**Note:** The responsibilities below reflect the core of this role today, but this is a fluid position, priorities, ownership areas, and day-to-day focus will shift as client needs and internal processes evolve. We're looking for someone comfortable operating in grey areas, without a fully defined playbook, and who can adapt accordingly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Advocacy & Service SLA Management:**  
  Serve as the main technical point of contact for key clients, delivering guidance on adopting and optimizing IAS' product offerings. Monitor and manage partner-specific technical support operations for IAS products and integrations to contractually defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response/resolution metrics. Review and interpret client contracts to understand defined SLAs, obligations, and risk areas, and apply that understanding to prioritize work, escalate appropriately, and guide client-facing decisions.
* **Workflow Automation:**  
  Audit internal processes to identify areas for automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven solutions to streamline day-to-day work.
* **Proactive Support:**  
  Monitor client health and key metrics with insights; flag anomalies, preempt issues, and ensure clients are positioned for success.
* **Enablement & Training:**  
  Deliver training sessions and supporting materials to upskill client teams on new AI-driven features and integrations.
* **Continuous Improvement & Feedback Loop:**  
  Gather and relay client feedback to Product and Engineering, advocating for new automation capabilities and smarter workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Partner closely with internal stakeholders across Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Operations to support account growth, align on feature roadmaps, and resolve complex technical escalations seamlessly. Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.
* **Client Travel:**  
  Occasional travel to client sites may be required to build relationships, deliver trainings, or conduct strategic technical reviews.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a TAM, platform support, or technical client success role (preferably in ad tech or SaaS).
* Experience working directly at or with major social platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and managing ongoing technical operations.
* Strong understanding of AI/automation in digital media; hands-on experience using or implementing AI tools.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and client communication skills, with a proven track record of managing and meeting strict contractual client SLAs.
* Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions, effectively collaborating across departments (Product, Engineering, Sales, BD) to achieve client objectives.
* Comfort operating in a fluid, evolving role with undefined or shifting responsibilities; adaptability is essential.
* BA/BS required.

### **Success Measures**

* **Client Satisfaction and Retention:** High client satisfaction scores and strong retention and growth of client business.
* **Operational Efficiency and AI-Implementation:** Measurable time savings and workflow improvements achieved for client support operations through implementation of AI tools.
* **Business Acumen in Practice:** Demonstrated ability to apply contract and SLA knowledge to day-to-day prioritization, escalation, and client management decisions.
* **Critical Thinking & Navigating Ambiguity:** Proven ability to operate in complex, undefined situations — applying critical thinking, building structure without formal guidance, and making sound decisions with incomplete information.

As part of IAS compensation package, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, health insurance (medical, dental, vision) as well as PPO, HSA and FSA options and 401k with employer matching contributions. All full-time employee roles include competitive compensation and are eligible for an annual bonus and/or other incentive plans.
